en.title: Transactions and Expenses
en.summary: Every movement of money that is not a customer collection, and the company's own spending.

sections.heading: The two screens
sections.body:
• Transactions — money in and money out, browsable by date range.
• Expenses — the company's own spending, by category. Add expense records one: category, amount, date, payment method, description and receipt. Categories manages the list the form chooses from.

Expenses wait in the Expenses approval queue before they count.

sections.heading: Do not enter payroll twice
sections.body: A payroll run writes its own transaction automatically, and so does an approved collection. If you find yourself typing one of those in by hand, it is already there — look for it before adding a second.

sections.heading: Categorise as you go
sections.body: The money report is only as useful as the categories underneath it. A month of everything filed under "other" cannot be analysed afterwards, and re-categorising later is guesswork.

am.title: ግብይቶችና ወጪዎች
am.summary: ከደንበኛ ክፍያ ውጪ ያለ እያንዳንዱ የገንዘብ እንቅስቃሴ፣ እንዲሁም የድርጅቱ ራሱ ወጪ።

sections.heading: ሁለቱ ገጾች
sections.body:
• ግብይቶች — ገቢና ወጪ በቀን ክልል ማየት ይቻላል።
• ወጪዎች — የድርጅቱ ወጪ በምድብ። Add expense አንዱን ይመዘግባል፦ ምድብ፣ መጠን፣ ቀን፣ የክፍያ ዘዴ፣ መግለጫና ደረሰኝ። Categories ቅጹ የሚመርጥበትን ዝርዝር ያስተዳድራል።

ወጪዎች ከመቆጠራቸው በፊት በወጪ ማጽደቅ ወረፋ ውስጥ ይጠብቃሉ።

sections.heading: ደመወዝን ሁለት ጊዜ አያስገቡ
sections.body: የደመወዝ ክፍያ የራሱን ግብይት በራሱ ይመዘግባል፤ የጸደቀ የደንበኛ ክፍያም እንዲሁ። ከእነዚህ አንዱን በእጅ እየተየቡ ከሆነ አስቀድሞ ተመዝግቧል — ሁለተኛ ከመጨመርዎ በፊት ይፈልጉት።

sections.heading: ሲያስገቡ ይመድቡ
sections.body: የገንዘብ ሪፖርት ጠቀሜታው ከበስተጀርባው ባሉት ምድቦች ልክ ነው። ሁሉም በ"ሌላ" ሥር የተመዘገበበት ወር በኋላ ሊተነተን አይችልም፤ ዘግይቶ መመደብም ግምት ነው።
